description:
CyberPulse: Global cybersecurity intelligence API — CVE briefs, vulnerability scanning, CISA KEV, OSINT, threat intelligence, ransomware tracking, breach checks, compliance gap analysis, dark web monitoring, and 

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • cve-check ($0.02): CVE fact check — NVD + CISA KEV + OSV joined, deterministic
  • cve-brief ($0.10): CVE deep-dive — CVSS, exploitation status, patch urgency, remediation
  • vuln-scan ($0.12): Vulnerability scan — all known CVEs for any software + version
  • cisa-kev ($0.08): CISA KEV — Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog search
  • osint ($0.15): OSINT — domain and IP intelligence for authorized defensive use
  • threat-intel ($0.20): Threat intelligence — global threat actors and campaigns by sector and region
  • ransomware-intel ($0.20): Ransomware intelligence — group profiles, victim patterns, TTPs, defensive playbook
  • breach-check ($0.15): Breach check — domain breach history and credential exposure intelligence
  • compliance-gap ($0.25): Compliance gap analysis — global security frameworks (SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR, NIS2, PDPA, POPIA, LGPD...)
  • dark-web-monitor ($0.20): Dark web monitor — brand and domain underground intelligence (ethical OSINT)
  • attack-surface ($0.25): Attack surface assessment — external risk analysis for authorized defensive use

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: cve-check | cve-brief | vuln-scan | cisa-kev | osint | threat-intel | ransomware-intel | breach-check | compliance-gap | dark-web-monitor | attack-surface

brand.description: Brand name or domain — e.g. acme.com | MyCompany

days.description: Entries added in last N days (default: 90)

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem — npm | PyPI | Maven | Go | crates.io | NuGet

group.description: Ransomware group name — e.g. LockBit | ALPHV | Cl0p | RansomHub (omit for landscape overview)

industry.description: Sector — e.g. healthcare | finance | energy | manufacturing | government | education

region.description: Region — e.g. North America | Europe | Southeast Asia | MENA | Sub-Saharan Africa | Global (default: Global)

sector.description: Industry sector — e.g. healthcare | finance | SaaS | e-commerce

software.description: Software name — e.g. Apache Log4j | OpenSSL | Spring Boot | Ivanti Connect Secure

target.description: Domain or public IP — e.g. example.com | 8.8.8.8

vendor.description: Vendor/product name — e.g. Cisco | Ivanti | Microsoft | Palo Alto | Fortinet

name: cyberpulse
